categories.title: Chadley
categories.info: Offers Combat Challenges, unlocked by fighting and Assessing local Fiends, or scanning crystals in Summon Sanctuaries. Can also craft Materia using World Intel Data Points.

categories.title: Chocobo Stop
categories.info: Use a Cushion on a Chocobo Stop to use it as a Rest Stop and replenish party HP and MP. Repaired stops can also be used as fast travel points, if you've wrangled the local Chocobo.

categories.title: Local Map
categories.info: Local Map points are places you can fast travel to that also have their own dedicated maps.

categories.title: Noticeboard
categories.info: Reveals the locations of any available Odd Jobs on the map, but they can be started without doing this.

categories.title: Place of Interest
categories.info: Places of Interest allow you to fast travel directly to them, however unlike Chocobo Stops and World Intel, you cannot choose to arrive on a mode of transport.

categories.title: Rest Spot
categories.info: Use a Rest Stop to recover the HP and MP of the entire party. In Hard Mode, they only restore HP.

categories.title: Snaps
categories.info: Talk to Snaps to unlock a region's Scenic Spot and a Photo Mode frame. Take a photo of the view there and then talk to Snaps to unlock new filters in the Photo Mode.

categories.title: Card Collector
categories.info: Queen's Blood Vendors sell all Booster Packs sold at Items Vendors, as well as individual Legendary Cards not available anywhere else.

categories.title: Changing Booth
categories.info: Stalls that allow you to customize outfits for the entire party while in Costa del Sol, including story outfits like the Shinra disguises in Junon.

categories.title: Chocoboutique
categories.info: Allow you to customize the cosmetics of the Chocobo you wrangled in a specific region.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Vendors that let you trade in Companion Cards earned from Costa del Sol minigames, in exchange for Cloud, Aerith and Tifa beachwear outfits.

categories.title: Items Vendor
categories.info: Items Vendors sell Items, Queen's Blood card packs, and Materia, but do not offer discounts like Vending Machines do.

categories.title: Maghnata Automat
categories.info: Maghnata Automats are used to customize the Folios of your party by spending SP to unlock new Skill Cores. They work just like Maghnata Books outlets.

categories.title: Maghnata Books
categories.info: Maghnata Books are used to customize the Folios of your party by spending SP to unlock new Skill Cores. They work just like Maghnata Automats.

categories.title: Tack Shop
categories.info: Tack Shops are used to buy many crafting materials, as well as new Chocobo Gear with Golden Plumes from caught Chocobos and Chocobo Stops. This gear can then be used in the Gold Saucer's Chocobo Races, each with their own perk.

categories.title: Vending Machine
categories.info: Vending Machines have more limited stock than bespoke outlets in towns, but often have a few one-time discounted items.

categories.title: Weapons Vendor
categories.info: Weapons Vendors offer Accessories, region-exclusive Armor, and Weapons. All Weapons available here can also be found for free inside purple chests, and almost all armor can be bought at a discount from a Vending Machine.

categories.title: Cache Location
categories.info: Cache locations are clusters of 2 to 3 chests nearby containing items, gear, or gil. Find all chests to complete the cache!

categories.title: Collector's Item
categories.info: Collector's Items are in-game trophies earned for completing various tasks and minigames, and are displayed in Johnny's Seaside Inn. Collect all 88 to unlock Johnny's Cache.

categories.title: Dorian
categories.info: Speak to Dorian after A-Ranking a piece of Sheet Music for the first time to be given a Level 2 Materia.

categories.title: Accessory
categories.info: Accessories are items that give various buffs when worn, as opposed to the Materia Slots and defense boosts of Armor.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor are items that have Materia Slots, and give defense boosts. A must for making the most of your Materia. Like Weapons, they are replaced with something else if you open their chest again via Chapter Select.

categories.title: Buried Treasure
categories.info: While riding a Chocobo, use their heightened sense of smell and sharp claws to unearth buried treasure across Gaia.
categories.template:
One possible location for the PLAY ARTS ??.

If you already have it, some ?? will be here instead.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests are boxes with yellow lights on them that can contain Items, Accessories, and Crafting Materials.

categories.title: Gil
categories.info: Gil is the currency used in all Final Fantasy games, and can be spent at Vendors for various goods.

categories.title: Item
categories.info: Items are defined as one-time consumables, ranging from restoring HP and MP, curing status effects, or impacting enemies.

categories.title: Materia
categories.info: Materia can be slotted into Weapons or Armor for various effects, including Spells, new Commands, passive buffs, and enhancing other Materia.

categories.title: Moogle Medal
categories.info: A medal with a Moogle on it. These medals can be exchanged at Moogle Emporiums for rare and exotic items.

categories.title: Weapon
categories.info: A free Weapon that you'd otherwise have to buy from a Weapons Vendor. If you already have the Weapon, the chest will have gil instead, equivalent to half the weapon's cost at a Weapon Vendor.

categories.title: Chocobo Intel
categories.info: Locations where you can wrangle a Chocobo that can only be used in that region. All your Chocobos will also be available in the Gold Saucer's Chocobo Races.
categories.template:
**Rewards:**
- 2x Golden Plumes
- 10 ?? Data Points
- 5 Party EXP

categories.title: Combat Assignment
categories.info: Fiend Intel are combat challenges against more powerful versions of local enemies, and offer bonus Party EXP for completing all Combat Objectives. Defeating these Fiends will unlock new challenges in Chadley's Combat Simulator.

categories.title: Dig Site
categories.info: Excavation Intel Sites are Chocobo dig sites that contain new Transmuter Chips, and are revealed by scanning enough Lifespring crystals in the region.

categories.title: Lifespring
categories.info: Lifesprings can be analyzed to unlock Dig Sites, Classified Fiends, and regional lore intel. They are also surrounded by many crafting materials.

categories.title: Moogle Mischief
categories.info: Complete Moogle Mischief to earn a Moogle Medal. Completing Moogle Mischief in each region will unlock a new Moogle Emporium, and upgrade all Emporiums with more stock.
categories.template:
**Reward:**
- 1 Moogle Coin
- 10 ?? Data Points (first win only)

categories.title: Protorelic
categories.info: Phenomenon Intel are a series of four tasks, usually minigames, that award a Protorelic by completing them.

categories.title: Remnawave Tower
categories.info: Remnawave Towers are structures that reveal other Intel sites when plugged into, usually requiring climbing up the tower.

categories.title: Secret Intel
categories.info: Classified Intel are secret boss enemies that can only be challenged after scanning all Lifesprings in the region.
categories.template:
**Prerequisite:** Analyze ?? ?? Lifesprings

**Classified Enemy:** [??]()

**Rewards:**
- 10 ?? Data Points
- 5 Party EXP

categories.title: Summon Crystal
categories.info: Summon Sanctuaries allow you to complete a minigame to strengthen that Summon's Materia and optionally make their Combat Challenge easier.

categories.title: Main Scenario
categories.info: Main Scenarios are the main Story quests that progress the game. These often expect you to do at least some available side content along the way to level up party members, and feature at least one boss.

categories.title: Minigame
categories.info: Minigames are side challenges that offer rewards for completing them. All minigames also have Collector's Items associated with winning their top prizes.
categories.template:
**Recurring Rewards:** 1 Moogle Coin

**First Win Rewards:**
- 10 ?? Data Points
- 5 Party EXP
- Moogle Emporium Rank Up

categories.title: Odd Job
categories.info: Odd Jobs are side quests that can be completed for rewards like Party XP and Manuscripts. Many Odd Jobs have better rewards if completed perfectly, including building character relationships.

categories.title: Queen's Blood Player
categories.info: Queen's Blood players offer a single QB Card as a reward for beating them. Standard players will get stronger to match Cloud's level, while Bosses stay at a fixed difficulty.

categories.title: Scenic Spot
categories.info: Scenic Spots, unlocked by talking to Snaps in that region, are areas where you can take a photo using your system's Photo Mode. Report your photo to Snaps to unlock a new Photo Mode filter.

categories.title: Sheet Music
categories.info: A-Rank one of the main six pieces of Sheet Music on any piano, then talk to Dorian to receive a Lv. 2 Materia.

categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Hard Fiends and other opponents that give 50 EXP, 10 AP, and gil and EXP for beating them.

categories.title: Chocobo Traversal
categories.info: Chocobo Traversal spots are unique ways to get around the world, or Chocobo items. Either will require the unique talent of a Chocobo native to the region.

categories.title: Classified Enemy
categories.info: Classified Enemies are boss Fiends that are unlocked by analyzing all Lifesprings in that region. Summon them by standing in their arena and holding down the Interact button for several seconds.

categories.title: Enemy
categories.info: Enemies, or Fiends, spawn in pre-determined locations across the world. This makes it possible to farm them for XP, AP and their item drops.

categories.title: Zipline
categories.template: A location for Refurbished Materials in [The Saga of Seaside Inn](https://mapgenie.io/final-fantasy-vii-rebirth/maps/midgar?locationIds=326873) Side Quest.
